title: CashEvent
description: An existing cash flow of one account, without the plan under evaluation (engine-spec §2 CashEvent). Negative amount = outflow. 'expected' events are dropped in scenarios with include_expected=false; expected inflows are delayed/scaled by the scenario; outflows of category 'living' are scaled by expense_scale. Same-day events: outflows before inflows unless the scenario orders by timestamp and every event of that day has 'at' (the plan's repayments do not count for that decision and come first on a timestamp-ordered day). An event whose date a scenario changes loses its 'at' (engine-spec §12.4).

at.description: Exact time if known (used only for same_day_order 'timestamp'). Its date, in its own offset, must be 'on' (adapter rule). Equal instants keep the order of the events array.
